h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Arrah

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Arrah

items.pText: School managements in Arrah often ask us one practical question: how much equipment does our ground actually need? FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Arrah and the rest of Bhojpur district to schools, coaching campuses, housing colonies and parks. We build everything at our factory in Vasai, about 1,390 km away, and send it to Bihar by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

The answer depends on how many children use the ground at the same time, more than on its size. A school that sends two sections out together needs enough play points for all of them, or children end up queuing for one slide. Each swing seat, see-saw end or merry-go-round seat counts as a play point, and a multi play system offers many at once. Arrah sits on the flat Gangetic plain, with hot summers, a heavy monsoon and cool winters, so raise the base where water collects.

items.q: How many pieces of equipment does a school playground need?
items.a: It depends on how many children play at the same time. Tell us that number and the size of the ground, and we will suggest a mix that gives every child something to do.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Arrah?
items.a: Yes. We make it at our Vasai factory and send it to Arrah by road. Our installation team or a dealer installs it, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

items.q: What should we do if our ground floods in the monsoon?
items.a: Raise the play area above the surrounding level, give it a slope and lay rubber flooring. Galvanised posts grouted into concrete stay firm even when the soil is wet.
